# Averiq design context

## Product

- Adaptive education workspace built with React, Vite, Tailwind v3, and custom Radix-style primitives.
- Comfortable application density with editorial reading surfaces.
- Time-aware light and dark chrome driven by the Living Nature environment.

## Sources

- Design tokens: `src/styles/tokens.css`
- Typography: `src/styles/typography.css`
- Environment styling: `src/styles/living-sky.css`
- UI primitives: `src/components/ui`

## Constraints

### Must

- Interpolate the environment continuously from local time and live sunrise/sunset when enabled.
- Treat weather as atmosphere, never as a content-blocking interaction.
- Preserve readable semantic surfaces and WCAG AA contrast across sky states.
- Honor reduced motion, lower visual quality, visibility state, and mobile safe areas.

### Avoid

- Full-screen photographic wallpaper behind application content.
- Repeated star tiles, looping rain stripes, frequent shooting stars, and periodic lightning.
- Hard scene cuts, layout-shifting animation, and decorative motion inside focus or reading modes.

## Decisions

- Keep the persisted `living-sky` key for backwards compatibility while labeling the experience Living Nature.
- Use procedural CSS and canvas layers with normalized time, weather, sun, and moon values.
- Reuse the existing primitives rather than add a parallel component library.
- Use Segoe UI Variable Text and a 16px body floor without a remote font dependency.
